subject: Luck B...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Hope you guys were treated well, and thank you Criterion for doing something like that for a new but growing site, life does happen in small steps, just sad i could not go, but i've got spell check problems, lol. And envious, emotional but very happy.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Thank You!!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Thank you Alex, we both had an amazing weekend with you guys. Thanks for inviting us and trusting us with your secrets!

I'm glad to see you finally got yourself a profile on the site too, I know you have been lurking for a long time!

Thanks again Alex! 😃
